# Software timer table

Ten 28-byte software timers: active, start time, event id and duration in ms.

**Category:** data · **Address:** `0x6036f984` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md)

Offsets: +0 active, +4 start time, +20 event id, +24 duration. Menus share event id 500 at 8000 ms; the super control panel uses 510.
